variants.name: 01-sunlit
variants.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: art-direction paintover of an existing Unity isometric ARPG game screenshot, for comparing achievable visual directions. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the exact elevated isometric game camera, wide 16:9 composition, all buildings and prop positions, paths, foliage masses and the small player character standing beside the blacksmith's chest near center. Keep the player's original identity, outfit, pose, position and gameplay scale; improve silhouette separation through local values and lighting. Keep the red-and-cream blacksmith awning, forge chimney, wood piles, barrels, fences and cropped tents in their original locations. Render a polished stylized 3D GAME FRAME, not a cinematic illustration or photorealistic scene. Unify materials and detail scale; make ground texture calmer and less noisy; retain well-defined large shapes and believable contact shadows. Remove the HUD, all UI text and borders, naturally reveal the environment behind them. No captions, no title, no collage, no new buildings, no extra characters, no rearranging the scene, no depth of field. Full landscape image. Direction 1 — SUNLIT PAINTERLY. Bright welcoming late-morning woodland camp. Fresh natural sage and emerald foliage with clearly grouped leaf masses, warm cream stone and muted terracotta cloth, clear honey sunlight and soft cool blue-green shadows. Hand-painted broad color variation, restrained texture, matte tactile stone, cloth and wood, subtle edge highlights. Airy luminous but not washed-out; warm forge has a localized amber glow without burning white. Strong readable 3D volumes, artfully simplified environment, rich but controlled color. A beautiful inhabited fantasy camp suitable for fast readable combat.
